sloka: स दीर्घ उष्ण महा उच्छ्वासः कोप संरक्त लोचनः ।बभूव नर शार्दूल स धूम इव पावकः ॥४-३१-२९॥
transliteration: sa dīrgha uṣṇa mahā ucchvāsaḥ kopa saṁrakta locanaḥ ।babhūva nara śārdūla sa dhūma iva pāvakaḥ ॥4-31-29॥

translations.english: Sighing hot, deep breath, eyes turned red in anger, this tiger among men appeared like fire with smoke (The sigh was smoke and red eyes, fire).
